Addis Ababa Edition 2026 Chapter I — The House of Readers Built for the turning of minds. Abrehot Library brings readers, students, researchers, families and makers together under one expansive roof. Its shelves, study spaces and gathering rooms make room for quiet concentration and the energetic exchange of ideas alike. 1.8M Annual readers and users 400K Books held at collection capacity 19K Square metres across four storeys 24/7 Reported around-the-clock access Abrehot Library Enlightenment for Ethiopia Filter Search the library catalogue Abner & me : a baseball card adventure / Dan Gutman. Posted by the office of the librarian The diary What’s on, month by month Open the calendar Chapter IV — The Company We Keep Held up by many hands. Abrehot works alongside city offices, ministries, universities and global libraries. Each partnership widens what a reader can reach from a single desk in Addis Ababa. Office of the Mayor of Addis Ababa World Vision Ethiopia UNISA University of South Africa Qatar National Library Doha JSTOR Digital research library Ministry of Education Ethiopia ITD3 Digital systems partner IPSS Addis Ababa University Education Bureau Addis Ababa City Administration Chapter V — Executive Leadership The people holding the next page open. The library stands under the patronage of the nation and the city, and is held day to day by a board and an executive team. Move through the plates to read each remit. Under their patronage H.E Taye Atske Selassie President of Ethiopia H.E Abiy Ahmed (Phd) Prime Minister of Ethiopia Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed initiated the Abrehot Library project, envisioned as a landmark center for knowledge, reading, and enlightenment. Under his initiative, the library was developed into a major public knowledge institution in Addis Ababa, officially inaugurated in January 2022. H.E Adanech Abiebie Mayor of Addis Ababa As Mayor of Addis Ababa, H.E. Adanech Abiebie has supported the continued development of Abrehot Library as a center for reading, research, and public knowledge. She has taken part in the library’s institutional development and championed its ongoing modernization and digital transformation.
